chunks: O Messenger, announce what has been revealed to you from your Lord, and if you do not, then you have not delivered His message; and Allah will protect you from the people. Indeed, Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Balloigh ma unzila ilayka' in the Quran?
ai.summary: Known as the Verse of Declaration (Ayat al--Da'wah), this verse is central to Shia exegesis as the divine command for the Prophet to announce the succession of Imam Ali (AS) at Ghadir Khumm. It emphasizes the necessity of completing the message of prophethood, with God's promise of protection ensuring the safe delivery of this critical religious duty despite opposition.
